Game Overview

In Funny Puppy Emergency, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the delightful world of Funny Puppy Emergency, where you become a vet for adorable puppies. Diagnose, treat, and creatively dress up your furry patients with intuitive controls. This vibrant and engaging journey offers a blend of medical care and fashion fun, perfect for young animal enthusiasts.
